_comment: Hand-labeled old/new content pairs for backend/detection/change_detector.py's first-stage filter. 'real' = a founder would want to know; 'noise' = cosmetic. '{page}' in a text is replaced with the long shared 'page' body below, so changes can sit deep in a realistic-length page (the old embedding detector could not see past the first ~200 words). Stage 1 is tuned for recall: it may pass borderline wording changes on to the LLM analyst (stage 2 rates their significance), so 'noise' examples marked stage2 are expected to pass stage 1 and are counted separately. Replace/extend with real snapshot pairs as they accumulate.
page: pricing plans for growing teams. our platform helps teams automate compliance evidence collection, monitor controls continuously, and prepare for audits with integrations across cloud providers, hr systems and identity tools. trusted by over two thousand companies. soc 2, iso 27001, hipaa and gdpr frameworks supported out of the box. continuous monitoring runs hundreds of automated tests every hour against your infrastructure and alerts the right owner when something drifts. policy templates are written by former auditors and can be customized in a few clicks. the trust center lets you share your security posture with prospects without a single email. vendor risk management tracks every third party you rely on, with questionnaires sent and scored automatically. employee onboarding and offboarding checklists keep access reviews tidy. our auditor network includes dozens of firms who already know the platform, which shortens the audit itself. customers typically reach audit readiness in weeks instead of months. starter plan $49 per month includes 5 users and email support. growth plan $199 per month includes 25 users, sso and priority support. enterprise plan contact sales for custom pricing, a dedicated success manager and a custom msa.
